patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,103 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.current_roll = 0
+        
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        if pins < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Negative roll is invalid")
+        if pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+            
+        # Check if game is already complete
+        if self.is_game_complete():
+            raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+            
+        # For frames 1-9, check if we're trying to roll too many pins
+        frame_index = self.current_roll // 2
+        if frame_index < 9:
+            # If this is the second roll of a frame and it's not a strike
+            if self.current_roll % 2 == 1 and self.rolls[-1] != 10:
+                if self.rolls[-1] + pins > 10:
+                    raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        else:
+            # 10th frame logic
+            # Get the rolls in the 10th frame so far
+            rolls_in_10th = self.rolls[18:] if len(self.rolls) >= 18 else []
+            
+            if len(rolls_in_10th) == 1:  # Second roll in 10th frame
+                # If first roll was a strike, second roll can be up to 10
+                # If first roll wasn't a strike, sum can't exceed 10
+                if rolls_in_10th[0] != 10 and rolls_in_10th[0] + pins > 10:
+                    raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+            elif len(rolls_in_10th) == 2:  # Third roll in 10th frame
+                # If we got here, first two rolls were either strike or spare
+                # If first two were strikes (10 + 10), third can be up to 10
+                # If it's a spare (first + second = 10), third can be up to 10
+                # But if first was 10 and second wasn't 10, then second + third <= 10
+                if rolls_in_10th[0] == 10 and rolls_in_10th[1] != 10:
+                    if rolls_in_10th[1] + pins > 10:
+                        raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                        
+        self.rolls.append(pins)
+        self.current_roll += 1
+        
+    def is_game_complete(self):
+        if len(self.rolls) < 18:  # Not even completed 9 frames
+            return False
+            
+        # Check 10th frame completion
+        if len(self.rolls) == 18:  # 10 frames of 2 rolls each
+            # Game is complete if 10th frame is open (not strike or spare)
+            tenth_frame_score = self.rolls[18-2] + self.rolls[18-1]
+            return tenth_frame_score < 10
+        elif len(self.rolls) == 19:  # 9 frames + 2 rolls in 10th + 1 more
+            # Game is complete if 10th frame was spare (but not strike)
+            tenth_frame_first = self.rolls[18]
+            tenth_frame_second = self.rolls[19]
+            if tenth_frame_first == 10:  # First roll was strike
+                return False  # Need one more roll
+            else:  # First roll wasn't strike
+                return tenth_frame_first + tenth_frame_second == 10  # Was it a spare?
+        elif len(self.rolls) == 20:  # Maximum rolls (3 in 10th frame)
+            return True
+        else:
+            return True
+            
+    def score(self):
+        if not self.is_game_complete():
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+            
+        total_score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        # Score frames 1-9
+        for frame in range(9):
+            if roll_index >= len(self.rolls):
+                break
+                
+            # Check for strike
+            if self.rolls[roll_index] == 10:
+                # Strike: 10 + next two rolls
+                total_score += 10
+                if roll_index + 1 < len(self.rolls):
+                    total_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                    total_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                roll_index += 1
+            else:
+                # Check for spare or open frame
+                frame_score = self.rolls[roll_index] + self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                total_score += frame_score
+                if frame_score == 10:  # Spare
+                    if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                        total_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                roll_index += 2
+        
+        # Score 10th frame
+        # The 10th frame is scored as the sum of all remaining rolls
+        while roll_index < len(self.rolls):
+            total_score += self.rolls[roll_index]
+            roll_index += 1
+            
+        return total_score
